item.title: Man charged for fatal hit-and-run motorcycle crash in Elkhart County
item.description: Eric Clifton Beal, 44, of South Bend, has been charged with two felony counts related to a fatal hit-and-run motorcycle crash that occurred on July 10, 2025, in Elkhart County, after an extensive investigation by the Elkhart Police Department Fatal Crash Team.

item.title: Boone County agencies monitoring weather in case shelters are needed
item.description: Multiple agencies in Boone County are coordinating their response to the snowstorm and preparing to provide temporary shelters if needed, with assistance available by calling the Boone County Communications Center.

item.title: IU falls to Kentucky in renewal of storied rivalry
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (WISH) — IU lost to Kentucky, 72-60, in the first regular season matchup of the rivalry since 2011. IU led 39-32 at halftime. IU gets back in action on Saturday, December 20 at home against Chicago State. Tipoff is scheduled for 1 p.m.

item.title: Bitter cold and snow to sweep central Indiana | Dec. 13, 2025
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting a significant winter storm with heavy snow and extreme wind chills tonight and tomorrow, followed by a gradual midweek thaw with temperatures climbing into the 40s by Wednesday.

item.title: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza wins Heisman Trophy
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza won the Heisman Trophy, becoming the first IU player to win the award, after leading the Hoosiers to a 13-0 record and their first Big Ten championship since 1967.
